test_title: PYST 16: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 04 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**For Option 1) RO−JJ:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72a83d87c48a425b24a6943fc67c7216139cfb529276e48044d81d6f0a661b5a.png] 

**For Option 2) YV−RO:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dbdc9c0c050f1ffb1d1603f8b16063cb61dbd555277d4437a26480542701631f.png] 

**For Option 3) HE−AX:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7abbcff5b46e3e6ad5ffc8fb94ab1e7cc4cb7f7008d10b0f25e0725b24d97ee1.png] 

**For Option 4) EB−XU:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61e2c6c19cb9081db1b6b4f2909a4a98b1ea8e6e282e6d04ce2253ee463b5d0b.png] 

Thus, the letter-cluster that DOES NOT belong to that group is** RO−JJ.**

 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
